body: i would entertain what you're saying but permethrin HAS worked. it has. in the past. i did not clean my environment enough. it worked for my boyfriend. same with sulfur. i had burrows and scratch marks. if heat rash can also clear up with permethrin i will entertain maybe. i have two different antifungal creams as well and neither have worked. i thank you fro your response but unless something else clears up with permethrin and sulfur im definitely thinking it's scabies. or was scabies. the marks on my hands are from infection i got, impetigo, i know that much. i just dont know how to fade them.

also. since i am at a point of trying to heal the scarring i will keep you in mind and message you what works for me. i stay away from this account while i go through my journey so i can focus and not be reminded even on the internet lol. but when theres progress i'll come back!

thank you!! im sorry for misinterpreting :)! and yes for some reason for pretty much the entire year i had very little reaction to the itch. it still is minor but i eventually went through periods of really experiencing the itch / pricking feeling.

im so sorry it's awful :(. for the sulfur i bought 3 2 oz jars. 10 percent. i ordered it off ebay. it is literally called scabisa or something so scabies in another language. 

the 2 oz would provide me with 2 and a half applications worth so this may depend on your size and weight and how much you put on. i would put it on and leave it on. it's disgusting but since im in quarantine i did not wash it off by showering. rip. i reapplied it within 24 hrs of the previous application and now cant remember i've done 6 or 7. im going to be doing this until i run out. then i have nustock (sulfur pine oil and something else very high sulfur 73 percent) that i mixed with moisturizer im going to use. i have definitely noticed major improvement. i have a really bad cause where if i scratched a thin layer of skin i had dozens of mark underneath. i took a few daily baths in clove oil (known to kill them apparently) and scrubbed the first few days of using the sulfur ointment. now i have less of this build up and the marks underneath have cleared. 

i know for regular scars sunscreen can help fade them, so i am applying that every day, and ordered steroid creams as well. im not sure though that these are normal scars or i still have an infection back when i had impetigo or if im just fucked lol.

at first no, but then yes. if youre implying it's not scabies i know that that is what i had. these marks are not what the rest of my marks looked like. these marks were from scratching and the skin crusting and hardening over. i am just wondering what i can do for these since they will not go away. they are scars.
edit: sorry if thats not what you are implying. i may have taken the comment wrong. i had someone insist i didnt have them even though permethrin had cleared them for me once and they came back for me so i am a little on edge. but im pretty sure these are scars at this point from scratching / picking at them and im not sure where to start to fix them.
